The checker confirmed one MLINESTYLE at handle 0x18; owner/reactor target 0x17; root ACAD_MLINESTYLE membership; Standard -> 0x18 owner entry; two ordered BYLAYER elements with offsets +0.5/-0.5; flags and description; and 90-degree start/end angles.
